svg.title: Work-order release and daily operation schedules
svg.desc: Work-order release and daily operation schedules. A supply recommendation supports a work order and its operations. Daily schedules match work-center calendar records on both center and date. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
